newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank cancels Friday notes auctions.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank cancels Friday notes auctions.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said it had cancelled three weekly notes auctions worth a total of three billion baht ($100 million) scheduled for Friday, July 18.

"Due to changing market liquidity, the Bank of Thailand (BOT) called off the auction for the BOT bonds...amounting to 2,000 and 1,000 million baht respectively on Friday, July 18," the central bank said in a statement.
Money market dealers said the liquidity in the banking system was tight on slow inflow of foreign funds following the adoption of a new managed float system for the baht.
